content.text:
Overdue notices now say how many days late the item is, for example "It is 5 days late." All 60 tests pass.

- **Template:** in `lib/notices/templates.js`, the overdue body now reads `… was due back on {dueOn}. It is {lateBy} late. Please return it to any branch.`
- **Days late:** `overdueNotices` in `lib/notices/digest.js` works out the number of days with `daysBetween(loan.dueOn, today)`. It says "1 day" for one day and "N days" otherwise.
- **Test:** I added a test in `test/notices.test.js` covering the "5 days" and "1 day" wording. It first failed because I assumed today was 11-27 and the test data uses 2026-11-26, so I corrected the loan dates in the test, not the code.

Two of my tool calls were denied, and neither changed anything: a read of `templates.js` at a mistyped path, and a `sed` command. I redid both properly, the read with the right path and the test-date change with the Edit tool.

I didn't record anything to Factloom or commit.
